about: Owner's classification of the ISL A3 (isl3) clips that need one: the four adhkar recorded in Dr. Hassan's own voice, the Learn-card clips, and whether each card is sacred. Read by scripts/import-json.ts.

sacred.approvalNote: Recorded in Dr. Hassan's own voice and chosen by him (adhkar), or an exact copy of an already approved clip (بِسْمِ اللهِ); approved in the audio review page on 2026-10-26

notSacred.note: Learn-card clips with names and terms only (no du'aa, dhikr or Qur'an); checked by Dr. Hassan by ear on 2026-10-26.
